notes: Parts are the same as in step 1; no changes.
Breadboard positions are read from the circuit image. The LED legs R, COM (longest pin), G and B go in columns 9, 10, 11 and 12 at row g, which is the catalogue's 'b' bank (rows f-j).
Each resistor spans the centre gap, from row f in the 'b' bank to row e in the 't' bank, in the same column as its LED leg (columns 9, 11 and 12).

The jumper wires end in the 't' bank: orange (pin 3) at 9t.d, green (pin 5) at 11t.c, blue (pin 6) at 12t.b. This gives red cathode on pin 3, green on pin 5 and blue on pin 6, each through a 220 ohm resistor.
The red wire runs from the Uno 5V pin to 10b.f, which is the same strip as the LED's common anode leg in column 10.
The common anode goes to 5V. The code comment says 'Anode: GND', but the circuit image and schematic show 5V, so 5V is used. No GND connection is drawn.
The catalogue's rgb-led is used with COM as the common anode.
